requirements.quote: 1. ALL MEDIUM VOLTAGE SWITCHGEAR EQUIPMENT AND ACCESSORIES TO BE RATED FOR 15,000V AND BASIC INSULATION LEVEL TO BE 95,000V.
requirements.text: Switchgear equipment must be rated for 15,000V and have a basic insulation level of 95,000V.

requirements.quote: 2. ENCLOSURE WILL BE METAL CLAD WITH BOTTOM FEED ON SECTIONS
requirements.text: Enclosure must be metal clad with bottom feed.

requirements.quote: 2. UTILITY METERING SECTION: TRANSFORMERS AND METERS PROVIDED BY UTILITY.
requirements.text: Utility will provide transformers and meters for the metering section.

requirements.quote: 3. TIE BREAKER SEQUENCE OF OPERATION: • FEEDER BREAKERS HANCOCK FEED AND SAND ROAD FEED ARE NORMALLY CLOSED. • TIE BREAKER IS NORMALLY OPEN. • LOSS OF VOLTAGE IN FEEDER (OPEN TRANSITION). • THAT BREAKER OPENS AND TIE BREAKER CLOSES. • MANUAL DISCONNECTING OF FEEDER (CLOSE TRANSITION - MAKE BEFORE BREAK) • UPON SATISFYING VOLTAGE REQUIREMENT, CLOSE TIE BREAKER WHEN BOTH FEEDERS ARE IN PHASE WITH SAME FREQUENCY. • AFTER 10 SECONDS, OPEN FEEDER BREAKER. • RETURN OF VOLTAGE IN FEEDER OR MANUAL SELECTION (CLOSE TRANSITION - MAKE BEFORE BREAK). • SATISFIED WHEN VOLTAGE IS PRESENT IN FEEDER FOR MINIMUM OF 15 MINUTES. • UPON SATISFYING VOLTAGE REQUIREMENT, CLOSE FEEDER WHEN BOTH FEEDER ARE IN PHASE WITH SAME FREQUENCY. • AFTER 10 SECONDS, OPEN BREAKER.
requirements.text: Tie breaker operation sequence must follow specified steps for voltage loss and restoration.

requirements.quote: 4. INTERLOCK SWITCH WITH BREAKER TO ALLOW CHANGE OF SWITCH POSITION ONLY WHEN FEEDER BREAKER IS OPEN (DISCONNECTED)
requirements.text: Interlock switch must allow position change only when feeder breaker is open.

requirements.quote: 5. CABLE PROVIDED BY UTILITY. TERMINATIONS BY CONTRACTOR.
requirements.text: Utility provides cable; contractor handles terminations.
